description: live:LIVE-13 — Ctrl+A (select every model of the active unit) shares the A key with the polled camera_pan_left binding, so holding Ctrl+A also panned the board ~330 px left under the models the player was about to drag. The player clicks the Kommandos, holds Ctrl (a real KEY_CTRL press, as the OS sends before the A) and Ctrl+A for 0.6 s: all 10 Kommandos are selected and the camera does not move. Control: a bare A held afterwards still pans the camera, so the polled pan path is live in this run.

steps.comment: setup privilege: Kommandos in the open bottom-left corner

steps.script:
var m = tree.current_scene
m.set_meta("cam0", m.view_offset)
var ev = InputEventKey.new()
ev.keycode = KEY_CTRL
ev.physical_keycode = KEY_CTRL
ev.ctrl_pressed = true
ev.pressed = true
Input.parse_input_event(ev)
return true
steps.comment: Ctrl goes down first, as on a real keyboard
the camera did not pan while Ctrl+A was held

steps.script:
var ev = InputEventKey.new()
ev.keycode = KEY_CTRL
ev.physical_keycode = KEY_CTRL
ev.pressed = false
Input.parse_input_event(ev)
return true

var m = tree.current_scene
m.set_meta("cam1", m.view_offset)
return true

steps.comment: control: a bare A still pans the camera
